title: The ball bounces
summary: A paddle and a ball bouncing everywhere. Speed tells where the ball goes.
done: You know how the ball moves and bounces.

hello.text: Here is **Brick Breaker**! Drag the paddle in the preview to send the ball back.

serve.text: A sprite has an **x speed** (to the right) and a **y speed** (downwards). The function gives both to the ball.

bounce.text: When the ball touches the paddle, its y speed becomes negative: it goes back up.

side.text: This calculation compares the x of the ball and the paddle: hit on the right, it goes right.

lost.text: The edges of the scene make things bounce. If the ball touches the bottom, we serve again.

slow.text: Start **slow motion** to see the blocks light up.

watch.text: Send the ball back with the paddle: [set y speed to -300] lights up.
watch.hint: Wait a little, or click “Restart” in the preview.

fast.text: Stop slow motion to play at normal speed.

faster.text: Serve the ball faster: 350 or more.

strong.hint: Keep the minus sign: it sends the ball up.

spin.text: Make the ball turn when it touches the paddle.
